limits: The alias regression uses synthetic packet bytes and proves the plugin write path plus ReXGlue alias visibility; it is not a retail gameplay transition test.
The same-run retail log proves physical stores to 0x17AF4000 and separate RPTR stores to 0x17AF403C, but does not prove the retail waiter read the virtual alias after those stores.

A hardware watchpoint attached only to the virtual host mapping may miss writes made through ReXGlue's separate physical mapping; a direct guest virtual read in the same retail run is needed to establish the observed value.
